weightDecision: After six sensitivity scenarios, retain equal dimension budgets and a shared poverty/HDI deprivation allocation as explicit project trade-offs, not externally approved importance coefficients. A 60/40 or 40/60 dimension split changes scores by up to 6.70 points and modeled order by up to eight places; fine rankings are not stable enough to emphasize. Five equal indicator weights shift scores by up to 10.51 points and are not selected. Independent substantive review remains required.
